reports.title: Page 1 – Tennant Company Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Guidance Reaffirmed
section: MINNEAPOLIS, MN (Nov. 2, 2026)—Tennant Company ("Tennant" or the "Company") (NYSE: TNC) today reported its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
